# registry-token-service

> A stateless Go service implementing the CNCF Distribution registry token
> authentication spec. It authenticates Docker push/pull clients via Ory Hydra
> (client_credentials) and authorizes per-repository actions via Ory Keto, then
> issues short-lived RS256 JWTs the registry validates directly. Runs on `scratch`
> as non-root UID 65534.

## Purpose

- Front-ends a CNCF Distribution (`registry:3`) instance for token auth.
- Delegates authentication to Hydra and authorization to Keto — never validates
  credentials or invents permissions locally.
- Issues RS256 JWTs whose `access` list is the intersection of requested scope and
  Keto-granted actions.

## Endpoints

- `GET /token` — HTTP Basic auth (`client_id:client_secret`), query params
  `service` (must equal `TOKEN_SERVICE`) and `scope`
  (`repository:<name>:<actions>`). Returns `{ "token", "expires_in", "issued_at" }`.
- `GET /healthz` — returns `200 {"status":"ok"}`.
- CLI: `-healthcheck` dials `/healthz` and exits 0/1 (container HEALTHCHECK).

## Configuration (environment variables)

- `PORT` (default 8080)
- `TOKEN_ISSUER` (required) — JWT `iss`
- `TOKEN_SERVICE` (required) — JWT `aud` / registry service name
- `TOKEN_TTL` (default 300 seconds)
- `RSA_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH` (default /etc/token-service/signing.key) — PEM RSA key, ≥ 4096-bit or the service refuses to start
- `HYDRA_TOKEN_URL` (required) — Hydra POST /oauth2/token
- `KETO_READ_URL` (required) — Keto read API base URL
- `LOG_LEVEL` (default info)

## Authorization model

- Keto namespace `Registry`; relations `pullers` (pull), `pushers` (push), `admins`
  (delete). pushers/pullers checked independently. Subjects = Hydra client_id.
- Two-tier object check for repository scopes: the specific `org/repo` object is checked
  first, then the `org` object (segment before the first `/`) as a fallback. An org-level
  grant covers all current/future repos in the org; per-repo grants take precedence.
- Catalog listing uses the `listers` relation on the fixed `catalog` object.
- Requesting more than granted yields a token scoped to the granted subset — never an error.

## Security invariants

- Keto is the source of truth for permissions; unreachable Keto → 503 (fail closed).
- Hydra validates credentials; unreachable Hydra → 503 (fail closed).
- RS256 only; signing key ≥ 4096-bit enforced at startup.
- Stateless: no token cache, no refresh; TOKEN_TTL honored.

## Supply chain

- Multi-arch images (amd64/arm64) on quay.io + Docker Hub.
- SBOM (SPDX) + SLSA provenance attached; keyless cosign signatures over the digest.
- Base image pinned by digest; reproducible build.
